# netbox_l2vpn (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/vpn/l2vpn/):

> An L2VPN is a layer 2 virtual network, such as a VXLAN or an MPLS EVPN, with its terminations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_l2vpn" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) One of [vpws, vpls, vxlan, vxlan-evpn, mpls-evpn, pbb-evpn, evpn-vpws, epl, evpl, ep-lan, evp-lan, ep-tree, evp-tree, spb].

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `export_target_ids` (Set of Number)
- `identifier` (Number)
- `import_target_ids` (Set of Number)
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `slug` (String)
- `status` (String) One of [active, planned, decommissioning].
- `tags` (Set of String)
- `tenant_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
